result.generation_response: This is an invoice from the Richmond, Virginia Police Department dated April 30, 2021, addressed to Tom Nash of MuckRock News. The invoice is for a FOIA (Freedom of Information Act) request seeking police data from 2013-2019, including: use of force incidents by year and type, civilian complaints (reported and sustained), use of force complaints (reported and sustained), biased policing/discrimination complaints (reported and sustained), and details of officer-involved shooting incidents including dates, race of subjects, and injuries/deaths. The invoice charges $80 for 2 hours of Major Crimes work at $40/hour and $20 for 30 minutes of Internal Affairs work at $40/hour, totaling $100. Payment is to be remitted to Richmond Police Department Central Records Unit at 200 West Grace Street, Richmond, VA 23220.

This is a header from the City of Richmond Police Department. It specifies accepted payment methods (Certified Check, Money Order, and Cash, with a warning not to mail cash). The document includes contact information for the police department: Chief Gerald M. Smith, located at 200 W. Grace Street, Richmond, VA 23220, with phone number 804.646.6700, fax 804.646.3974, and website www.ci.richmond.va.us/police/.
